located_observations.location: left photographic view, shade through oval base
located_observations.observation: Complete deep-green lamp, wide half-cylinder curved shade, two distinct cylindrical supports joined to shade and base, full ellipse base. Warm light falls onto open blank book in foreground.
Whole-product photograph changes to enlarged illuminated page and cropped same lamp underside; photo scale shift and page arc define the sheet, with copy adjacent to seam.
Two prose sentences are adjacent and continuous, but body glyphs are about 9–10 px tall and much smaller than the event line; reading requires close attention.
Visit conditions, invitation and URL continue the same optical start. Invitation ending crosses a darker page-edge shadow and loses contrast.
Whole lamp/foreground book and macro book frame remain legible as a two-view sequence. Title and event name are strongest type anchors; prose becomes fine texture.

text.note: Literal comparison stored separately; raster range punctuation read by shape, not Unicode provenance certification.

style.observation: Whole lamp/book view and illuminated-page macro joined by vertical photo edit; photographic depth and specific book layers organize copy placement.

substantive_visual.observation: Large product and illuminated real-book photographs depict structure and desk-light experience; no tiny icon substitute.

typography.observation: Stable Hangul proportions, mostly open counters, regular baseline and semantic wrap of long description; mature sans body. Small prose/visit glyphs at usage720 are the practical limit.
typography.word_spaces_observation: Meaningful word boundaries visible; no isolated syllable line or stretched justification.

information_relationship.observed_route: lamp and book → macro light contact → adjacent descriptive sentences → event/date/time/place → visit conditions → invitation → URL
information_relationship.limitation: Prose and invitation too fine compared with headline/event at 720; invitation ending has lower contrast.

function_contact.observation: Both supports visibly join underside and oval base; base grounded on walnut desk. Book open beneath luminous shade, with warm desk/page light. No hands requested or shown.

material_edges.observation: Lamp rim, cylinder joints and oval base clear; natural photographic desk texture and page layers. Right paper has relatively uniform bright typing area but retains fold, curved edge and lit underside.

exclusion.observation: Two specific photo distances and book/shade edit define overall image. The full lamp is a substantive image anchor; book close-up provides visible light and page structure adjacent to copy. It is not an empty-room type wall or passive colour field.

residuals.limit: Approximately 9–10 px body glyph height; paragraph and visit detail less comfortable than requested usage-size reading.

residuals.location: invitation line ending on right page shadow
residuals.limit: Dark letters lose some contrast at the curved page-edge shadow.
